cancel_order: You can cancel an order within 1 hour of placing it from Order History on our website or app. After that window, contact support with your order number and we'll cancel it if it hasn't shipped yet.
change_order: To change an order (size, quantity, address), contact support with your order number as soon as possible. We can only make changes before the order ships.
change_shipping_address: You can update your shipping address from Account Settings before an order ships. Once it's shipped, contact support with your order number — we may be able to redirect it with the carrier.
check_cancellation_fee: There's no cancellation fee if you cancel within 1 hour of placing the order. After that, a fee may apply if the order has already entered processing.
check_invoice: Invoices are available under Order History on our website or app. Select the order and choose 'Download Invoice'.
check_payment_methods: We accept Visa, Mastercard, and cash on delivery within Lebanon.
check_refund_policy: Items can be returned within 14 days of delivery, unworn and with tags attached. Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5-7 business days of us receiving the item.
complaint: We're sorry to hear you had a bad experience. Please share the details and your order number if relevant, and our support team will follow up directly.
contact_customer_service: You can reach our support team by email at support@anchorlogisticslb.com, or through live chat on our website, available Monday-Saturday, 9 AM-8 PM (Beirut time).
contact_human_agent: To speak with a support agent directly, use the live chat on our website or email support@anchorlogisticslb.com. Our team responds during business hours, Monday-Saturday, 9 AM-8 PM (Beirut time).
create_account: You can create an account from our website or app by selecting 'Sign Up' and entering your email and a password.
delete_account: To delete your account, contact support at support@anchorlogisticslb.com from your registered email, and we'll process the request within a few business days.
delivery_options: We deliver across Lebanon and the wider MENA region. Standard delivery takes 2-4 business days domestically, 5-8 business days internationally. Express (next-day) delivery is available in Beirut.
delivery_period: Standard delivery takes 2-4 business days within Lebanon and 5-8 business days internationally. You'll receive a tracking link by email once your order ships.
edit_account: You can update your account details (email, phone, password) from Account Settings on our website or app.
get_invoice: You can download your invoice anytime from Order History on our website or app.
get_refund: Once we receive a returned item, refunds are processed to your original payment method within 5-7 business days.
newsletter_subscription: You can subscribe to our newsletter from the footer of our website, or manage your subscription from Account Settings.
payment_issue: If a payment failed or looks incorrect, check that your card details are up to date and try again. If the issue continues, contact support with your order number.
place_order: You can place an order directly through our website or app by adding items to your cart and checking out with a saved or new payment method.
recover_password: Select 'Forgot Password' on the login page and follow the link sent to your registered email to reset it.
registration_problems: If you're having trouble creating an account, make sure your email isn't already registered and that your password meets the minimum requirements. If the issue continues, contact support.
review: You can leave a review for a delivered order from Order History on our website or app.
set_up_shipping_address: Add or edit a shipping address from Account Settings, or enter a new one directly at checkout.
switch_account: To switch between personal and business accounts, go to Account Settings and select 'Switch Account Type'.
track_order: You can track your order from Order History on our website or app using your order number, or via the tracking link sent to your email once it ships.
track_refund: Refund status can be checked from Order History on our website or app. Refunds typically appear within 5-7 business days of us receiving the returned item.
